audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Jax at 3/10 while whys[0] calls it even, and levels 3 and 4-5 were given to you at 6/10 — the exact window in which Counter Strike comes online and Empower's cooldown collapses.
audit.why: The mirror audit on jax__vladimir settled and applied Skill, Skill, Jax, Jax, Jax, Vladimir, Vladimir: neither of you has a tool at level 1, he owns the stretch from Counter Strike through his level-6 ult, and your items take it back — which is what 55.01% over 1398 games looks like.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2 and 3 flipped as matched win[N] + phases[N].side pairs with ratings rescaled, and whys[1] through whys[6] rewritten so every row's explanation states that row's owner.

audit.whatIsWrong: Counter Strike is named on nine fields without a cooldown, and Jax's real ramp — Empower going from 7s to 3s — was never mentioned.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9, so a baited E at rank 1 leaves him with no stun for 17 seconds. Empower is 7/6/5/4/3, which is why levels 4-5 belong to him. Grandmaster-at-Arms is 110/100/90 and gives armour, MR and a third-hit magic proc.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into dosFull[0].d, whys[2], whys[3] and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Counter Strike as a blanket defensive window ('Dodges autos + stuns', 'pool his burst') and never states the one thing that matters: it dodges incoming attacks, not abilities.
audit.why: Riot's text says Jax 'dodges all incoming attacks for a short duration'. Vladimir's damage is entirely spells, so Transfusion and Tides of Blood land through the whole dodge — meaning you should keep casting into his E, not hold everything, and the pool belongs on the stun release rather than the dodge window.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and spikes[0].text.

edits.before: Jax gets his Counter Strike stun online and the Leap Strike all-in threat, so level 2 favours him.
edits.after: Level 2 is even — he gains Leap Strike, but your Tides of Blood costs health, not mana, so you keep poking.

edits.before: By level 3 you can pool his stun and answer with Transfusion, evening the fight out.
edits.after: By level 3 Counter Strike is online: 17s at rank 1, and eating it loses the trade.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay skill-based as both of you trade cooldowns and neither commits fully.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are his: Empower drops toward 3s and his passive keeps stacking attack speed.

edits.before: Level 6 is even — your Hemoplague amp offsets his ult, so the fight hinges on execution.
edits.after: Level 6 is his — Grandmaster-at-Arms adds armour, MR, and a third-hit magic proc.

edits.before: Jax's ult resists and empowered on-hit make his post-6 all-in strongest, tilting first-item timing to him.
edits.after: Your first item flips it: Riftmaker sustain out-lasts his single-target trades and he needs a minion to leap.

edits.before: With two items your ranged sustain and pool-immunity to his burst pull the extended matchup back to even.
edits.after: With two items your ranged sustain and Hemoplague amp beat him in any fight where he cannot isolate you.

edits.before: Jax wants to E-stun you and all-in once he has Leap Strike plus Counter Strike; if you Sanguine Pool through the E windup the stun whiffs and his commitment turns into free Transfusion pokes.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges basic attacks, not abilities — your Transfusion and Tides land through it untouched, so keep casting and save the pool for the stun release rather than the dodge window.

edits.before: Dodges autos + stuns. Pool his burst. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: E dodges basic attacks only — keep casting Q and E through it, 17s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Jax's Counter Strike: Dodges autos + stuns. Pool his burst. When it is down — Q-E + R him.
edits.after: Counter Strike (E) dodges attacks, not abilities — your Transfusion and Tides land through it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Empower falls to 3s and every third hit of his R burns magic.

notes: 'Land Counter Strike' is a FALSE POSITIVE in suspectNames — Counter Strike is correct. Left untouched, as the mirror did: the claim that Sanguine Pool cancels the Counter Strike stun. Riot's text does not say whether untargetability during the 2s pool prevents the stun on release, and the page's advice does not depend on it once you know abilities land through the dodge. The mirror also flagged that content early, late and spikes[0] were written in first person; my spikes[0] rewrite removes it there, early and late still need a voice pass.
